params.note: Decision-problem solved-count metric: 57 QBFEVAL'20 judged instances (with within-block permutation transformation); B/K are per-instance solved flags (0/1). Anchor convention: B=1 iff the baseline qute wrapper produced a certificate accepted by the judging pipeline on the transformed instance within the judging budget (900 s per instance, the official QBFEVAL'20 limit). Since 260913, anchors match the judging budget (plan A in qbf-b-anchor-caliber-260913.md (historical report not included in this package)); previously the threshold was the 20 s convention designed on 260831. Timings come from a matching environment on 2026-09-03 (isolated execution environment isolated-cpu 4C/16G in judge-v4; baseline run for 900 s per instance, recorded in B_seconds/B_status in reference-transformed.json). K=1 is the reference solved state and is unchanged. The engine excludes B==K: both1=25, both0=8, leaving 24 scored instances. 260911 anchor correction: verifier-side anchors originally used the 260831 original-instance convention (S_B=33), while the judging image from 260903 carried an unthresholded flag meaning solved within 900 s (S_B=25). This drift caused ex023 to be incorrectly excluded on the judging side and 9 instances to be excluded twice; the batch E oracle falsely scored 0.333 (see qbf-anchor-drift-260911.md (historical report not included in this package)). 260913 alignment: the 20 s threshold did not match the 900 s judging budget, causing a nonzero nop. The shipped baseline deterministically solved two threshold-sensitive instances within the judging budget: ex008 (34.73 s) and ex023 (43.9 s), which had old anchors B=0, K=1. The nop was consistently 2/26=0.0769 (evidence: k-ratchet-qbf-smt-260913.md (historical report not included in this package)). Changing B from 0 to 1 on both makes them both1, so the engine excludes them and nop returns to 0; the judging-image reference was rebuilt to match (judge-v12). Per-key audit: only these two of the 57 keys had an accepted certificate with time in (20,900] in the matching 2026-09-03 measurement. The other 23 keys with status ok and time ≤20 s remain 1; 32 rejected/timed-out keys remain 0. Per-key table: per-key-audit.tsv. (historical report not included in this package)
